answer: Some tasks have a known wrong answer. Seed them at random and watch who returns it. An agent that copies a neighbour's result hands back the planted error and gets caught. The failure is published with the task id and the nonce it arrived with, so the same trap cannot be learned and dodged. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, which kills replay across epochs. Honest agents lose a little time on the decoys. A farm loses a whole batch, because one leaked answer moves through the clones like a whisper through a hollow garden. The cost lands per copy, not per task.
